MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle feels like a useful next addition because it brings home monitoring to the Alexa devices I recently bought.",
    "The USB extension cables and cleaning duster support equipment I already use: easier connections and routine upkeep fit my history of buying practical computer accessories."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Echo Show or nearly identical Echo Dot feels redundant after my recent purchases; sharing the same ecosystem does not give me a reason to buy another device.",
    "Using storage accessories does not mean I currently need a 512GB memory card or an enclosure for a bare NVMe drive.",
    "The headphones, earbuds, and tablet do not address a current need for me; my computer accessories and streaming devices do not imply that I want personal audio or another screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to be treated as a reason to recommend more Alexa devices, even when they repeat functions I just added.",
    "My interest in computer and storage accessories seems to be stretched into interest in loosely related electronics without a clear use for them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Echo Show stand purchase suggests I am equipping the display I already have, which makes useful additions more relevant than another display.",
    "Compatibility matters when an item serves a purpose: home monitoring adds a function, and USB extensions help existing equipment, while specialized storage needs evidence that I have something to use it with."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my connected-home and computer interests but sometimes confuse useful additions with redundant devices or unsupported new needs."
}
